body:
# 🌱 GrowSpam Plugin – *Twerk your way to harvest!* 🍃

Tired of waiting for crops and trees to grow? Just **sneak (twerk)** next to them and watch the magic happen! 🕺✨

![gif exemple](https://s14.gifyu.com/images/bNLi4.gif)

---

## 💡 Features
- 🌾 **Grow by Sneaking** – Crops and trees grow faster when you sneak near them!
- 🎲 **Customizable Growth Chance** – Fully configurable percentage chance for each sneak/desneak action.
- 🧩 **Per-Block Control** – Enable or disable each growable block **individually** in the `config.yml`.
- 🔄 **Reload Command** – Use `/growspam reload` to instantly apply config changes without restarting the server!

---

## 🔐 Permissions
- ✅ `growspam.use` – Required to activate growth by sneaking.
- 🔧 `growspam.reload` – Required to reload the plugin config.

---

🪴 Make your server more fun and interactive with **GrowSpam** – where farming gets funky! 🌟
